as_told.title: Sheldrake's paper on the conscious sun and stars

plain: A guest on a podcast about consciousness and UFOs, James Madden, mentions a paper by the writer Rupert Sheldrake titled "Is the Sun Conscious?". Madden calls it really interesting, and raises it because, if the Sun could have a mind of its own, consciousness might be far more widespread in the universe than we usually assume.
